meta.title: Interactive replies
meta.description: Persistent Vue/JavaScript chat interfaces: forms, tables, charts and local drafts. Trusted execution without a sandbox.

autoRunNew: Auto-run new interfaces in this session
history: Code is paused. Review its source before running; historical interfaces never automatically replay.
inherited: Interface from another session: submitting replies is disabled.
revisionNotice: Your current draft stays separate. New code will not run automatically.
pending: Submission outcome unknown. Retrying keeps the exact identifier and values.
otherWindowSending: This card is being submitted in another window.
runtimeStopped: Execution stopped after an error. Source is available below.
gesture: Submit by pressing a button in the interface.
unavailable: Sending to this session is unavailable.
stale: This interface has been replaced by a newer revision.
storage: Could not save the submission identifier. Check local storage access.
tooLarge: Values must be JSON no larger than 32 KiB.
draftNotice: Drafts stay in this browser; only submitted replies enter session history.
draftStorage: Could not save the browser draft.
draftCorrupt: The saved draft is corrupt. Clear it explicitly to start again.
draftConflict: Another window changed this draft. Autosave stopped; stop and run the interface to load the saved version.
label: Label
validation.step: Value does not match the step
missing-card: This card is no longer in the current projection.
stale-revision: The form revision is stale; apply the new revision.
already-submitted: A reply to this revision was already accepted.
already-admitted: A reply to this revision is already queued.
invalid-time-zone: Could not determine the browser time zone.
